name: @scavio/mcp-server

tools.name: extract_url
tools.description: Read any web page as Markdown, text, or HTML. Tier-priced: normal=1cr, advanced(JS render)=1cr, ultra(hardest pages)=2cr. Start normal, escalate on empty/blocked. Only billed on success.

url.description: http(s) URL. Bare hosts upgraded to https. Private/loopback rejected.

tools.name: map_website
tools.description: List a site's page URLs from its sitemaps and start page (deduplicated, path-filtered, with lastmod when known). Obeys robots.txt. 1 credit (normal). Use to pick pages for batch_extract.

search.description: Only URLs containing every word of this text (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Max links (default 200 here). Plan caps: Free 500, PAYG 1,000, paid 5,000.

sitemap.description: 'include' (default) sitemaps + page links; 'only' sitemaps; 'skip' page links.

include_paths.description: Path globs to keep (* one segment, ** any depth), e.g. ["/blog/**"].

exclude_paths.description: Path globs to drop (* one segment, ** any depth), e.g. ["/blog/**"].

ignore_query_parameters.description: Merge URLs differing only by query. Default true.

tools.name: crawl_website
tools.description: Crawl a site from one URL and extract its same-site pages as Markdown/text/HTML. Starts a job and waits up to wait_seconds: returns results if done, else the job id for get_crawl_status. Per successful page: normal 1cr, advanced 1cr, ultra 2cr; failed/skipped pages free. Obeys robots.txt. Max pages: Free 10, PAYG 100, Project 500, Bootstrap 2k, Startup 5k, Growth 10k. Results kept 3 days.

url.description: Start URL; pages under its path are crawled first.

max_depth.description: Link depth to follow (default 3; 0 = start page only).

include_paths.description: Path globs to crawl (* one segment, ** any depth), e.g. ["/blog/**"].

exclude_paths.description: Path globs to skip (* one segment, ** any depth), e.g. ["/blog/**"].

ignore_query_parameters.description: Merge URLs differing only by query. Default true.

sitemap.description: 'include' (default) also seeds from the sitemap; 'skip' links only; 'only' sitemap pages, no link following.

webhook_url.description: Optional https URL that gets a signed POST when the job ends; secret returned once as webhook_secret.

idempotency_key.description: Optional; the same key within 24h returns the original job.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to finish (default 30).

max_content_chars.description: Clip each page's content to this many chars (default 4000).

tools.name: get_crawl_status
tools.description: A crawl's status, page counts, credits used and page results (paged by cursor). Can wait for it to finish. Free.

id.description: Job id from the start call.

include_content.description: false = results without content. Default true.

max_content_chars.description: Clip each page's content to this many chars (default 4000).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to finish (default 0).

tools.name: cancel_crawl
tools.description: Stop a running crawl; nothing more is billed and results so far stay readable. 409 if already finished. Free.

id.description: Job id from the start call.

tools.name: batch_extract
tools.description: Extract a list of URLs in one job, each as Markdown/text/HTML, results in input order; invalid URLs are reported, never billed. Waits up to wait_seconds: returns results if done, else the job id for get_batch_status. Per successful page: normal 1cr, advanced 1cr, ultra 2cr; failed/skipped pages free. Obeys robots.txt. Max URLs: Free 10, PAYG 50, Project 100, Bootstrap 500, Startup/Growth 1k.

webhook_url.description: Optional https URL that gets a signed POST when the job ends; secret returned once as webhook_secret.

idempotency_key.description: Optional; the same key within 24h returns the original job.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to finish (default 30).

max_content_chars.description: Clip each page's content to this many chars (default 4000).

tools.name: get_batch_status
tools.description: A batch's status, page counts, credits used and results in input order (paged by cursor). Can wait for it to finish. Free.

id.description: Job id from the start call.

include_content.description: false = results without content. Default true.

max_content_chars.description: Clip each page's content to this many chars (default 4000).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to finish (default 0).

tools.name: cancel_batch
tools.description: Stop a running batch; nothing more is billed and results so far stay readable. 409 if already finished. Free.

id.description: Job id from the start call.

tools.name: company_enrich
tools.description: Find a company's contact details and its owner from its website or a Google Maps place_id: published emails, phone numbers, social profiles (facebook, instagram, linkedin, x, tiktok, youtube, pinterest) and the contact page, plus the owner or founder's name and title with source_url, the page that names them. Use it after google_maps_search: pass each local result's place_id to turn a list of local businesses into leads. Returns data.company {name, website, domain, emails[], phones[], socials, contact_page, address, place_id}, data.owner {name, title, source_url, email, email_status} or null when no page names one. Provide url or place_id. 10 credits from a url, 20 from a place_id (1 when the listing has no readable website); a site that cannot be reached is free. Takes 10-45s.

url.description: The company's own website; a bare domain works. Not a social profile (that is a 400). Provide this or place_id.

place_id.description: A Google Maps place_id from google_maps_search. The listing is looked up first, then its website is read. 20 credits instead of 10.

tools.name: search_google
tools.description: Search Google, return SERP results with organic, ads, AI Overview. 1 credit.

location.description: Location name, auto-encoded to UULE, e.g. 'Austin,Texas,United States'. Localizes the local pack only; set web_only for organic results ranked for this location.

web_only.description: Google's Web results only: organic_results ranked for location (local rank tracking). No local pack, ads, PAA or AI Overview; call again without it for local_results.

tools.name: google_custom_search
tools.description: Google search in the Custom Search JSON API (CSE) format: items[] with title/link/snippet/displayLink, searchInformation, queries.nextPage. Use when porting CSE code or when items[] is wanted; search_google returns the richer full SERP. 1 credit.

site_search.description: Site to include/exclude, e.g. 'example.com'. Enforced on results.

or_terms.description: Space-separated; each result has at least one.

tools.name: google_ai_mode
tools.description: Google AI Mode: synthesized answer with cited sources. 1 credit.

tools.name: google_maps_search
tools.description: Search Google Maps for local businesses and places. Each result carries a place_id: pass it to company_enrich for the business's emails, phones, socials and owner. 1 credit.

tools.name: google_maps_place
tools.description: Google Maps place details. Provide place_id or data_cid. 1 credit.

tools.name: google_maps_reviews
tools.description: Google Maps reviews for a place. Provide data_id or place_id. Paginate with next_page_token. 1 credit.

tools.name: google_shopping
tools.description: Search Google Shopping for products with prices across retailers. Returns the top 10 shopping_results by default (limit to change). Pass catalog_id+query to google_shopping_product for detail. 1 credit.

limit.description: Max shopping_results returned (default 10). Local trim, same cost.

tools.name: google_shopping_product
tools.description: Google Shopping product detail and sellers. Pass catalog_id+query for full data. 1 credit.

tools.name: google_shopping_stores
tools.description: Paginate google_shopping_product sellers. 1 credit.

tools.name: google_flights
tools.description: Search Google Flights. Requires departure_id, arrival_id, outbound_date; set return_date for round trip (type=1). 1 credit.

tools.name: google_hotels
tools.description: Search Google Hotels. Pass detail_token from results to google_hotels_detail. 1 credit.

tools.name: google_hotels_detail
tools.description: Google Hotels property detail from a detail_token. 1 credit.

tools.name: google_news
tools.description: Google News results. Query or browse via topic/story/publication token. Returns the first 20 news_results by default (limit to change). 1 credit.

limit.description: Max news_results returned (default 20). Local trim, same cost.

tools.name: google_trends
tools.description: Google Trends interest data. Comma-separate up to 5 terms to compare on one 0-100 scale. 1 credit for one term, 3 credits for a comparison.

data_type.description: Dataset to return. GEO_MAP_0, RELATED_QUERIES, RELATED_TOPICS accept a single term only.

tools.name: google_trending
tools.description: Google Trending Now searches for a country. Returns the first 50 trends by default (limit to change; a day can have 400+). 1 credit.

limit.description: Max trends returned (default 50). Local trim, same cost.

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.description: Search YouTube videos. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 2 credits.

tools.name: search_youtube_shorts
tools.description: Search YouTube Shorts. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 2 credits.

tools.name: youtube_search_suggestions
tools.description: YouTube search autocomplete suggestions for a query. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_youtube_video
tools.description: Get YouTube video details: title, channel, stats, description, chapters, captions. 1 credit.

video_id.description: Video ID or watch URL, e.g. 'dQw4w9WgXcQ'.

tools.name: get_youtube_metadata
tools.description: Deprecated alias of get_youtube_video. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_youtube_comments
tools.description: Get comments on a YouTube video. Each has a reply_cursor for get_youtube_comment_replies. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_youtube_comment_replies
tools.description: Get replies to a YouTube comment. Requires reply_cursor from get_youtube_comments. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_youtube_transcript
tools.description: Get a YouTube video's transcript/captions. 5 credits.

tools.name: get_youtube_related
tools.description: Get related/recommended videos for a YouTube video. Single page, no pagination. 1 credit.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (endpoint accepts but never returns one).

tools.name: search_youtube_channels
tools.description: Search YouTube channels by keyword. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_youtube_channel
tools.description: Get a YouTube channel's profile. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_youtube_channel_videos
tools.description: List a YouTube channel's videos. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_youtube_channel_shorts
tools.description: List a YouTube channel's Shorts. No view count available. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_youtube_channel_community
tools.description: List a YouTube channel's community posts (data.posts). Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: resolve_youtube_channel
tools.description: Resolve a YouTube @handle or URL to its canonical channel ID. Other channel tools accept handles directly. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_youtube_streams
tools.description: Get direct media stream URLs for a YouTube video. 3 credits.

tools.name: get_youtube_community_post
tools.description: Get a single YouTube community post: text, author and channel id, likes (vote_count), comment count, attachment type and images, and comments_cursor for get_youtube_community_post_comments. 1 credit.

post_id.description: Community post id or post URL, e.g. 'Ugkx_PqHZYEoCCP7e8WIOrh-1HCvtKoFMzVp'.

tools.name: get_youtube_community_post_comments
tools.description: Get comments on a YouTube community post (data.comments) with likes, reply counts and author. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

post_id.description: Community post id or post URL.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page, or comments_cursor from get_youtube_community_post.

tools.name: search_amazon
tools.description: Search Amazon products. No sort option (always relevance). No category/price filter. 1 credit/page.

country.description: Country, e.g. 'us'. UK is 'gb'. Unknown codes silently fall back to us.

tools.name: get_amazon_product
tools.description: Full Amazon product page for an ASIN. Price is buy-box price; use get_amazon_offers for competing sellers. 1 credit.

country.description: Country, e.g. 'us'. UK is 'gb'. Unknown codes silently fall back to us.

tools.name: get_amazon_offers
tools.description: All sellers for an Amazon ASIN with prices and conditions. First page only, no pagination. 1 credit.

country.description: Country, e.g. 'us'. UK is 'gb'. Unknown codes silently fall back to us.

tools.name: get_amazon_options
tools.description: List supported Amazon marketplaces and country codes. Free, no args.

tools.name: search_walmart
tools.description: Search Walmart products. Returns the first 20 products by default (limit to change; a page holds up to ~70). Paginate with page while has_more_pages. 1 credit (US/CA), 2 credits (Mexico). Optional store targeting: pass delivery_zip + store_id together (store_id from get_walmart_stores, same domain) for one store's assortment and availability - walmart.com and walmart.ca only, 2 credits, takes 10-60s, store echoed in data.location.

fulfillment_type.description: 'in_store' for pickup only. Omit for all.

delivery_zip.description: Shopper postal code: 5-digit US ZIP, or Canadian postal code (e.g. 'M5V 2T6') with domain 'ca'. Must be passed with store_id.

store_id.description: Walmart store id from get_walmart_stores (same domain). Must be passed with delivery_zip. The store used is echoed in data.location.

limit.description: Max products returned (default 20). Local trim, same cost.

tools.name: get_walmart_product
tools.description: Get full Walmart product detail. No reviews (use get_walmart_reviews) or offers (use get_walmart_offers). seller_catalog_id is the NUMERIC id for seller endpoints. 1 credit. Optional store targeting: delivery_zip + store_id together (store_id from get_walmart_stores) - 2 credits, takes 10-60s, store echoed in data.location; 404 if that store does not carry the item. domain 'ca' only with a store pair.

delivery_zip.description: Shopper postal code: 5-digit US ZIP, or Canadian postal code (e.g. 'M5V 2T6') with domain 'ca'. Must be passed with store_id.

store_id.description: Walmart store id from get_walmart_stores (same domain). Must be passed with delivery_zip. The store used is echoed in data.location.

tools.name: get_walmart_stores
tools.description: Find Walmart stores near a US ZIP (walmart.com) or Canadian postal code (domain 'ca'), nearest first: store_id, name, distance_miles, address, coordinates, hours. Use a store_id with delivery_zip on search_walmart or get_walmart_product (same domain) to target that store. 1 credit.

zipcode.description: 5-digit US ZIP, e.g. '50036', or Canadian postal code with domain 'ca', e.g. 'M5V 2T6'.

tools.name: get_walmart_reviews
tools.description: Get Walmart product reviews. 10/page, paginate with page param. Includes rating_breakdown and top positive/negative. 1 credit/page.

tools.name: get_walmart_category
tools.description: Browse Walmart category products (no query). Same shape as search_walmart. Paginate with page while has_more_pages. limit trims locally (doesn't reduce cost). 1 credit (US/CA), 2 credits (Mexico).

limit.description: Max products to return (local trim, same cost).

tools.name: get_walmart_offers
tools.description: Get the buy-box offer for a Walmart product. Returns only the winning seller (not full offer list). Not paginated. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_walmart_seller
tools.description: Get a Walmart seller's storefront. IMPORTANT: seller_id must be NUMERIC seller_catalog_id (not the GUID seller_id, which 404s). 1 credit.

tools.name: get_walmart_seller_products
tools.description: List a Walmart seller's products. HARD CAP: ~40 products max (no pagination). Use total_count for real catalog size. seller_id must be NUMERIC seller_catalog_id (GUID 404s). 1 credit.

tools.name: search_reddit
tools.description: Search Reddit posts. Relevance order only, no sort/filter. Paginate with next_cursor. Slow (5-15s). 1 credit.

tools.name: get_reddit_post
tools.description: Get a Reddit post by URL or post id. Does NOT return comments (use get_reddit_post_comments). Slow (5-15s). 1 credit.

post_id.description: Post fullname (t3_...) or bare id. Either this or url required.

url.description: Full Reddit post URL. Either this or post_id required.

tools.name: get_reddit_search_suggestions
tools.description: Get Reddit search autocomplete suggestions. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_reddit_post_comments
tools.description: Get top-level comments for a Reddit post. Paginate with next_cursor. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_reddit_comment_replies
tools.description: Get replies to a Reddit comment. Requires post_id and reply_cursor from get_reddit_post_comments. 1 credit.

cursor.description: reply_cursor from a comment in get_reddit_post_comments.

tools.name: get_reddit_subreddit
tools.description: Get subreddit metadata (description, subscribers, type, etc). 1 credit.

tools.name: get_reddit_subreddit_posts
tools.description: List posts in a subreddit. Paginate with next_cursor. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_reddit_user
tools.description: Get a Reddit user's profile. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_reddit_user_posts
tools.description: List a Reddit user's submitted posts. Paginate with next_cursor. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_reddit_user_comments
tools.description: List a Reddit user's comments. Paginate with next_cursor. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_reddit_popular
tools.description: Get Reddit's site-wide popular feed. Paginate with next_cursor. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_reddit_trending
tools.description: Get Reddit's current trending search queries. 1 credit.

tools.name: search_reddit_comments
tools.description: Search Reddit comments by keyword (data.results): comment text, author, score, date, permalink, plus the post and subreddit it was left on. Sort by relevance, hot, top or new. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: search_reddit_subreddits
tools.description: Find subreddits by keyword (data.results): name, description, subscriber count, NSFW and quarantine flags, URL. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_profile
tools.description: Get a TikTok user's profile. Returns sec_user_id needed by the user_posts/followers/followings/similar/playlists tools. 1 credit.

sec_user_id.description: Secure user ID from a previous request.

tools.name: get_tiktok_user_posts
tools.description: List a TikTok user's videos. Requires sec_user_id. Paginate with max_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

count.description: Max videos returned (1-30). Pages return up to ~10 videos whatever you request, so page with max_cursor for more.

tools.name: get_tiktok_video
tools.description: Get TikTok video details: caption, stats, play URLs, author, music. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_video_comments
tools.description: Get comments on a TikTok video. Paginate with data.cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_comment_replies
tools.description: Get replies to a TikTok comment. Paginate with data.cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: search_tiktok_videos
tools.description: Search TikTok videos by keyword. Paginate with data.cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: search_tiktok_users
tools.description: Search TikTok users by keyword. Paginate with data.cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_hashtag
tools.description: Get TikTok hashtag stats. Returns ID for use with get_tiktok_hashtag_videos. 1 credit.

hashtag_id.description: Numeric hashtag ID from a previous request.

tools.name: get_tiktok_hashtag_videos
tools.description: List TikTok videos for a hashtag. Requires hashtag_id from get_tiktok_hashtag. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_user_followers
tools.description: Get a TikTok user's followers. Pass both page_token and min_time together for next page. 1 credit.

min_time.description: From previous response, must accompany page_token.

tools.name: get_tiktok_user_followings
tools.description: Get accounts a TikTok user follows. Pass both page_token and min_time together for next page. 1 credit.

min_time.description: From previous response, must accompany page_token.

tools.name: get_tiktok_trending_searches
tools.description: Get the search terms trending on TikTok right now (data.trending_search_words, about 90 per call). US-weighted, no region filter. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_trending_videos
tools.description: Get a sample of videos trending on TikTok now (data.itemList) with author, stats, sound and hashtags. Each call returns about 6 videos whatever count is set (up to 15); call again for a fresh sample. No region filter. 1 credit.

count.description: Requested videos, 1-15 (default 15). About 6 come back per call.

tools.name: get_tiktok_search_suggestions
tools.description: Get TikTok search autocomplete suggestions for a keyword (data.data[].word). Long-tail keywords can return none; that is still a billed answer. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_music
tools.description: Get a TikTok sound by id (data.music_info): title, artist, album, duration, how many videos use it (user_count), original vs commercial, play URL, cover, and chart rank when charting. 1 credit.

music_id.description: The sound's numeric id (music id_str from a video, search_tiktok_music or get_tiktok_music_chart).

tools.name: get_tiktok_music_videos
tools.description: List videos that use a TikTok sound (data.aweme_list). About 14 per page whatever count is set; paginate with data.cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

count.description: Videos per page, 1-30 (default 10). Ignored upstream; pages hold about 14.

tools.name: search_tiktok_music
tools.description: Search TikTok sounds by keyword (data.music): id_str, title, artist, duration, usage count and play URL. Paginate with data.cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_music_chart
tools.description: Get TikTok's Top 50 or Viral 50 sound chart (data.music_list) with each sound's details and trend. One global chart, no region filter. Paginate with data.cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_user_similar
tools.description: Get creators similar to a TikTok user (data.users, about 30 per page) with follower, following, video and like counts, bio and verification. Paginate with data.next_page_token/has_more. 1 credit.

sec_user_id.description: sec_user_id from get_tiktok_profile, get_tiktok_user_region or a user record's sec_uid.

tools.name: get_tiktok_user_playlists
tools.description: List a TikTok user's playlists (series) in data.playList: mixId, name, video count, cover. Accounts without playlists return an empty list. Paginate with data.cursor/hasMore. 1 credit.

sec_user_id.description: sec_user_id from get_tiktok_profile, get_tiktok_user_region or a user record's sec_uid.

tools.name: get_tiktok_playlist_videos
tools.description: List the videos in a TikTok playlist (data.itemList). Paginate with data.cursor/hasMore. 1 credit.

playlist_id.description: The playlist's numeric id (mixId from get_tiktok_user_playlists).

tools.name: get_tiktok_user_live
tools.description: Check whether a TikTok user is live now: user, live room status (2 = live, 4 = not live), title, start time and current viewer counts. An unknown username is a billed 404. 1 credit.

username.description: TikTok username, with or without the @, e.g. 'mrbeast'.

tools.name: get_tiktok_user_region
tools.description: Get the region a TikTok account is registered in (ISO country code, not the creator's nationality), plus user_id and sec_user_id. An unknown username is a 404 and not billed. 1 credit.

username.description: TikTok username, with or without the @, e.g. 'mrbeast'.

tools.name: search_tiktok_shop
tools.description: Search TikTok Shop products (US only). Has exact prices. ~44% of IDs resolve on get_tiktok_shop_product. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_shop_search_suggestions
tools.description: TikTok Shop keyword autocomplete. 1 credit.

region.description: Region: US (default), GB, SG, MY, PH, TH, VN, ID.

tools.name: get_tiktok_shop_product
tools.description: Get TikTok Shop product detail (no price - use search/category/shop tools for prices). ~44% of search IDs resolve; 404 is normal, don't retry. 1 credit (billed even on 404).

region.description: Region: US (default), GB, SG, MY, PH, TH, VN, ID.

tools.name: get_tiktok_shop_product_reviews
tools.description: Get TikTok Shop product reviews. Works for most IDs even when get_tiktok_shop_product returns 404. Paginate with has_more. 1 credit.

region.description: Region: US (default), GB, SG, MY, PH, TH, VN, ID.

tools.name: get_tiktok_shop_categories
tools.description: Get the TikTok Shop category tree. Use IDs with get_tiktok_shop_category_products. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_shop_category_products
tools.description: List TikTok Shop products by category with exact prices. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tiktok_shop_shop_products
tools.description: List a TikTok Shop seller's products with exact prices. Paginate with next_cursor/has_more. 1 credit.

region.description: Region: US (default), GB, SG, MY, PH, TH, VN, ID.

tools.name: resolve_tiktok_shop_url
tools.description: Resolve a TikTok Shop URL or share link to product_id or shop_id. 1 credit.

url.description: TikTok Shop URL or share link.

tools.name: get_instagram_profile
tools.description: Get an Instagram user's profile: bio, follower/following/post counts, verification and user_id. 1 credit.

user_id.description: Numeric user ID from a previous request.

tools.name: get_instagram_user_posts
tools.description: List an Instagram user's posts, about 12 per page. Pass pagination_token from the previous response as cursor. 2 credits per page.

count.description: Max posts returned; upstream may fetch more, extras are trimmed.

tools.name: get_instagram_user_reels
tools.description: List an Instagram user's Reels. Paginate with next_max_id. 1 credit (2 the first time a username is looked up).

tools.name: get_instagram_user_tagged
tools.description: List posts an Instagram user is tagged in. Paginate with next_max_id. 1 credit (2 the first time a username is looked up).

tools.name: get_instagram_user_stories
tools.description: Get an Instagram user's active stories. Not paginated. 2 credits.

tools.name: get_instagram_post
tools.description: Get a single Instagram post/reel. Provide url, media_id, or shortcode. media_type: 1=image, 2=video, 8=carousel. 2 credits.

tools.name: get_instagram_post_comments
tools.description: Get comments on an Instagram post. Provide shortcode or url (not media_id). Paginate with next_min_id. 2 credits per page.

tools.name: get_instagram_comment_replies
tools.description: Get replies to an Instagram comment. Requires media_id (from get_instagram_post) and comment_id (pk from get_instagram_post_comments). 2 credits.

tools.name: search_instagram_users
tools.description: Search Instagram users by keyword. 2 credits; a request with a cursor (rank_token, next page) costs 8.

tools.name: search_instagram_hashtags
tools.description: Search Instagram hashtags by keyword. 2 credits; a request with a cursor (rank_token, next page) costs 8.

tools.name: get_instagram_user_followers
tools.description: Get an Instagram user's followers. Paginate with next_max_id/has_more. 2 credits per page.

tools.name: get_instagram_user_followings
tools.description: Get accounts an Instagram user follows. Paginate with next_max_id/has_more. 2 credits per page.

tools.name: get_instagram_user_highlights
tools.description: List an Instagram user's story highlights: highlight id, title, cover and media_count. Pass an id to get_instagram_highlight_stories. 2 credits.

tools.name: get_instagram_highlight_stories
tools.description: Get every story saved in one Instagram highlight, with image and video URLs and posting time. 2 credits.
